newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM and shippers work on code of conduct.
newsitem.headline: KLM and shippers work on code of conduct.

text.p: KLM Cargo and the Dutch shippers organisation, the EVO, are working on a Code of Conduct agreement, a KLM Cargo spokesman told Reuters.
The Dutch airline already has Code of Conduct agreements with some large forwarders such as Road Air and MSAS.
Final details of the agreement are expected to be finalised "in a reasonably short time".
Because the code it still under discussion the spokesman was not willing to comment on exact details but said it would cover items such as the introduction of surcharges and rates increases.

Talks on a possible Code of Conduct came to light following the introduction of a fuel surcharge late last year when shippers complained that they did not have enough notice from the airlines when it wasintroduced.
The Code would include a structure for giving shippers ample lead time to adapt to any new charges, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
